content.title: 2026 WWE WrestleMania 42 Livestream: Watch Pro Wrestling Online Stream
content.text: Home Shopping News WWE WrestleMania 42 Livestream: Here’s Where to Watch the Two-Night Pro Wrestling Event Live Online Ethan Miller/Getty Images If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Variety may receive an affiliate commission. After a thrilling and dazzling WWE Elimination Chamber: Chicago, WWE travels to Las Vegas for an epic WWE WrestleMania 42 — a premium live event starting on Saturday, Apr. 18. The event features eight title bouts, including matches for the Undisputed WWE Championship, Women’s World Championship, World Heavyweight Championship, Women’s Tag Team Championship, WWE Women’s Championship and others. Related Stories In 2025, WWE made news with WrestleMania 41 becoming the highest-grossing event in the company’s history. Last year’s event increased viewership by 114% year-over-year from 2024. With growth like that, it’s very likely that 42 may overshadow 41. Want to watch WWE WrestleMania 42 online? Here’s what you need to know. When Is 2026 WWE WrestleMania 42? Date, Time WrestleMania 42 takes place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada on Saturday, Apr. 18 and Sunday, Apr. 19. The start time is 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT for both nights. How to Watch WrestleMania 42 Live Online The two-night WWE event livestreams exclusively on ESPN Unlimited, so the only way to watch it is to purchase a subscription starting at $29.99/month. Subscribe to ESPN Unlimited for the WWE premium live event starting at $29.99/month. Aside from WrestleMania 42, ESPN Unlimited is home to all things ESPN with access to all of its networks and streaming services, like ESPN, ESPN2, ESPN3, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN on ABC, ESPN Deportes, ESPN+, SECN, ACCN, SECN+ and ACCNX. In addition, you can go with a subscription to the Disney Streaming Bundle — which includes ESPN Unlimited, Hulu and Disney+ — starts at $35.99/month, an almost 40% savings on all three services. While some WWE events in the past have been pay-per-view, WrestleMania 42 is not a PPV event, so there is no PPV price needed. You can watch WrestleMania online simply with an ESPN Unlimited subscription. WWE WrestleMania 42, Main Card Check out the main card for both nights below, and stream it on ESPN Unlimited here. WrestleMania 42 Main Card: Night One, 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT Cody Rhodes (champion) vs. Randy Orton — Undisputed WWE Championship Stephanie Vaquer (champion) vs. Liv Morgan — Women’s World Championship AJ Lee (champion) vs. Becky Lynch — Women’s Intercontinental Championship Fatal 4-Way: Irresistible Forces (champion) vs. Bella Twins vs. Charlotte Flair & Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley & Lyra Valkyria — Women’s Tag Team Championship Seth Rollins vs. Gunther Drew McIntyre vs. Jacob Fatu Logan Paul, Austin Theory and iShowSpeed vs. The Usos and LA Knight WrestleMania 42 Main Card: Night Two, 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT CM Punk (champion) vs. Roman Reigns — World Heavyweight Championship Jade Cargill (champion) vs. Rhea Ripley — WWE Women’s Championship Sami Zayn (champion) vs. Trick Williams — United States Championship Finn Balor vs. Dominik Mysterio Ladder Match: Penta (champion) vs. Je’Von Evans vs. Rusev vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rey Mysterio — Intercontinental Championship Brock Lesnar vs. Oba Femi How to Watch WrestleMania 42 on TV WrestleMania 42 event is streaming exclusively on ESPN Unlimited online, so it is not airing ESPN on cable TV. If you want to watch WrestleMania on TV, you can watch it on your smart TV through the ESPN app. Livestream all of the WWE WrestleMania 42 action online starting at 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT on Saturday, Apr. 18 and Sunday, Apr. 19 on ESPN Unlimited. Preshow begins at 3 p.m. ET/12 p.m. PT for both nights. Later in the week, tune into “WWE Smackdown” after WrestleMania 42.
